turns.prompt_text: I just bought a watch and I would like to tune it to the correct time Attached 1 file. - d136959f-4432-4694-8f98-beceae68b936
turns.response_html:
To set the time on your FMD model FMDJO310 (which uses a standard Japanese quartz movement), you can follow these simple steps. Since this is an analog watch with a crown on the side, the process is straightforward:

Steps to Set the Time

  1. Pull out the Crown: Locate the small dial (the crown) on the right side of the watch case. Carefully pull it out away from the watch. It should "click" into its outer position.
    • Note: If the watch is new, check for a small plastic spacer/stopper between the crown and the case. If there is one, slide it out and discard it.
  2. Rotate to Adjust: Turn the crown clockwise (or counter-clockwise) to move the hour and minute hands to the correct time.
  3. Push the Crown Back In: Once the hands are set, push the crown all the way back in toward the case. You should feel it click into place, and the second hand should begin moving immediately.

Quick Tips for Your Watch

  • Battery: Your watch likely uses a standard SR626SW battery. If the watch stops ticking in the future, that is the replacement size you'll need.
  • Water Resistance: According to the manufacturer specs for this model, it is generally "water-resistant" for daily use (like light splashes), but do not submerge it in water or wear it while swimming, as the seals are not designed for pressure.
  • Cleaning: Use a soft, dry cloth to wipe the "Base Metal Bezel" and "Stainless Steel Back" to keep it from tarnishing over time.
